title: 第9章  生死战书！
content_zh:
楚天雄此话一出，姬邀月顿时语塞。
身后柳如烟也是心头一颤。
宗主这分明是在维护陆烬！
“可是宗主，此子三年前便是废物，如今有了如此修为，必是在魔窟之中修炼了魔道功法，不然，绝不会到达如此境界！”
“而我万剑宗，从来与魔道势不两立，此子，绝不能留！”
闻言，楚天雄皱眉：
“姬峰主，你在教我做事？”
话语淡然，却透着一股不容亵渎的威仪！
姬邀月又是一愣，楚天雄贵为宗主，九品金丹境的超级强者，可不是她一个峰主能得罪的！
“属下不敢！”
楚天雄面无表情，然后看向陆烬：
“失踪三年，如今强势归来，的确可疑。”
说完，他手掌一探，一道灵力钻入陆烬体内，龙蛇般游走。
陆烬所有气息内敛，葬天棺瞬间消失无踪。
葬天棺内有青莲女帝坐镇，楚天雄想要查探根本不可能！
而当那道灵气探查到帝霸琉璃骨，以及无尽丹田之后，楚天雄的眸色大变！
虽无法探查其究竟达到何等层次，却深知，陆烬的机缘，绝对非同小可。
不过，他很快便收起了眸中的震惊，反而淡笑点头：
“好，很好！”
说完，他抬眸扫视四方，声音朗朗：

“本座已亲自探查过陆烬的气息，此子体内灵力雄浑，并不掺杂半点邪魔气息，尔等若再以此为由，想要灭杀我万剑宗天才，本座可不答应！”
一句话说出，众人眸色全变了！
他们明白，楚天雄这是一定要保他了！
的确，陆烬之前所展现出来的实力太过强悍，甚至连圣女柳如烟都差点被杀，这绝对是天才中的天才！
三年归来，他非但早已不是废物，还脱胎换骨，成为了能抗衡金丹境强者的妖孽！
此时的柳如烟，眸中浮现难以遏制的怒意，可如今宗主现身，连她师尊姬邀月都无法左右此事，想要灭掉陆烬，只能再寻时机。
“此子身上的秘密，绝不简单！你要寻找机会，将他拿下！”
柳如烟脑海中响起狐师的声音。
“狐师，我一定会的！”
她暗暗攥紧拳头，强行收起了内心的不甘。
而楚天雄话音落下后，他竟是伸出手去，轻轻拍了拍陆烬肩膀：
“今日有她师尊在，你想复仇是不可能了，你打不过姬邀月。”
闻言，陆烬皱眉。
楚天雄对自己的态度，倒是出乎所料！
不过，眼下自身情况也的确如楚天雄所说，他的战力消耗太大，非要硬拼的话，面对姬邀月，根本没有胜算。
从这一点看，楚天雄一出现就救了自己，这是一份恩情。
而楚天雄对待陆烬的这般态度，也是引起了在场所有人的诧异。
神龙见首不见尾的宗主，能做出如此亲昵举动，足以彰显他对陆烬的心思。
楚天雄继续道：
“不如这样，一个月后，血月圣地会在八部血龙坛选拔弟子，而按照万剑宗规矩，在那场选拔的前三日，我万剑宗会先行选出参加八部血龙坛选拔的优秀弟子，到时候你们再行决斗，有仇报仇有怨抱怨，我等宗门高层，断然不会插手，你意下如何？”

听着这话，在场众人面色皆是一变！
没想到宗主竟会说出这种话，不过，他们也能看出来，宗主这是要给陆烬一个机会，当然，也给柳如烟一个机会。
二人都是武道天才，都是他万剑宗的优秀弟子，不足一个月的时间虽然短，却有着无限可能，到时候鹿死谁手，不得而知！
而宗门最后要留下的，一定是那更强的一个！
陆烬闻言，微微点头，然后说道：
“宗主大人！”
“我没记错的话，那场决斗中，任何一名弟子都可前去挑战，而且，若双方同意，还能签订生死状？”
闻言，众人顿时便明白了陆烬的意图，他是要在那场决斗中，与柳如烟来一场生死斗！
楚天雄表情古井不波，点头道：
“不错，能进入血月圣地的人，无一不是出类拔萃的武道修士，若无法活到最后，那还算什么天才？”
陆烬眸色冰冷，看向柳如烟，冷声道：
“那，我今日便与你下生死战书！柳如烟，你这位万剑宗圣女，可敢与我一战！”
此话一出，在场众人纷纷看向柳如烟！
现在看来，陆烬虽修为还处于灵珠境，可他的战力似乎已经超越了柳如烟！
而一个月后，陆烬又能成长到什么地步，无从得知！
但是，那时候的他，战力必定更加强悍！
而柳如烟身上虽有至尊骨，却正如陆烬所说，并未完全融合，她能修炼到什么地步，更是难下定论。
柳如烟暗暗磨牙，看向姬邀月。
而姬邀月并未立刻开口。
陆烬之前，拼尽全力之下竟能跟她对峙，这足以说明，他身上还有不为人知的秘密！

不知对方底细，这才是最危险的！
而就在这时，狐师的声音又在柳如烟脑海响起：
“答应他！”
“不出十日，你便有望冲击二品金丹境，到时候，你便有资格修炼大掠夺仙术第二层功法，一旦练成，哪怕四品金丹境，你都有一战之力！到时候杀他，易如反掌！”
听闻此言，柳如烟暗暗点头，旋即看向陆烬，声音冰冷的说道：
“好！我答应你！”
此话说出，姬邀月的眸色也是一变。
“如烟，你确定要与他上生死擂？”
“师尊放心，我如今突破二品金丹在即，一旦突破，战力飙升，他区区一个灵珠境，想杀我，绝无可能！”
姬邀月微微点头：
“既如此，那…为师会全力助你突破！”
“多谢师尊！”
姬邀月说着，看向楚天雄：
“宗主，事已至此，那属下先行告辞！”
说着便带着柳如烟离开了。
陆烬看着柳如烟那离去的身影，虽不甘心，却只能暂时按下。
不过，苏醒过来短短几日，他的修为便突飞猛进到这般地步，他倒是对二十多日后的生死擂台，充满期待！
“陆烬，你随我来。”
楚天雄淡淡说道，旋即抓过陆烬胳膊，二人原地消失。
而圣女峰上，亲眼目睹这一战的众人个个心情复杂。

“没想到这个陆烬三年归来，竟强大到如此地步！”
“连宗主都出面保他，若他能战胜圣女，前途无量！”
“想在生死擂台杀了圣女？呵呵，圣女大人可是杨巅峰师兄看中的人，而且传言，血月圣地的赤羽长老已经内定她加入圣地，陆烬若敢杀圣女，那就是在打血月圣地的脸！”
“陆烬师兄被陷害这三年，是怎么挺过来的？我倒是想看到他强大起来……”
“……”
众人议论间，那罗鹫长老等人眸色却更加复杂。
今日之事，他们无疑是彻底得罪了陆烬。
若陆烬在那场生死擂上真杀了圣女，恐怕他们的下场会很凄惨！
就在几人纠结之时，忽然收到传音符。
“姬峰主召见？诸位随我来！”
content_en:
As soon as Chu Tianxiong said these words, Ji Yaoyue was speechless.
Liu Ruyan behind him also felt his heart tremble.
The sect leader is clearly protecting Lu Jin!
"But Master, this boy was a waste three years ago. Now that he has achieved such a level of cultivation, he must have practiced the magic method in the devil's cave. Otherwise, he would never have reached such a state!"
"And we, the Wanjian Sect, have never been at odds with the demonic power. This son must not be allowed to stay!"
Hearing this, Chu Tianxiong frowned:
"Master Ji, are you teaching me how to do something?"
The words were indifferent, but there was a majesty that could not be blasphemed!
Ji Yaoyue was stunned again. Chu Tianxionggui was the sect master, and a super strong man in the ninth-grade golden elixir realm was not someone she, the peak master, could offend!
"My subordinates dare not!"
Chu Tianxiong had no expression on his face, and then looked at Lu Jin:
"It's indeed suspicious that he's been missing for three years and now he's back with such force."
After saying that, he touched his palm, and a stream of spiritual power penetrated into Lu Jin's body and swam away like a dragon and snake.
Lu Jin restrained all his aura, and the burial coffin disappeared without a trace in an instant.
Empress Qinglian is sitting in the burial coffin, and it is impossible for Chu Tianxiong to investigate!
And when the spiritual energy detected the emperor's glazed bones and the endless dantian, Chu Tianxiong's eyes changed drastically!
Although it is impossible to find out what level he has reached, he knows that Lu Jin's opportunity is definitely not trivial.
However, he quickly put away the shock in his eyes and instead smiled and nodded:
"Okay, good!"
After finishing speaking, he raised his eyes and glanced around, his voice loud and clear:
"I have personally examined Lu Jin's aura. The spiritual power in his body is strong and there is no trace of evil spirit. If you use this as an excuse to kill me, the genius of Wanjian Sect, I will not agree!"
After saying this sentence, everyone's eyes changed completely!
They understood that Chu Tianxiong must protect him!
Indeed, the strength Lu Jin showed before was so powerful that even the saint Liu Ruyan was almost killed. This is definitely a genius among geniuses!
After returning after three years, not only is he no longer a waste, he has also been transformed into a monster who can compete with the strong men in the Golden Core Realm!
At this time, Liu Ruyan had uncontrollable anger in her eyes, but now that the sect master had appeared, not even her master Ji Yueyue could influence this matter. If she wanted to destroy Lu Jin, she could only look for another opportunity.
"The secret of this boy is by no means simple! You have to look for opportunities to take him down!"
Master Fox's voice sounded in Liu Ruyan's mind.
"Master Fox, I will definitely do it!"
She secretly clenched her fists and forcibly put away her inner reluctance.
After Chu Tianxiong finished speaking, he actually reached out and patted Lu Jin on the shoulder:
"With her master here today, it's impossible for you to seek revenge. You can't beat Ji Yaoyue."
Hearing this, Lu Jin frowned.
Chu Tianxiong's attitude towards him was unexpected!
However, his current situation is indeed as Chu Tianxiong said. His combat power is too consumed. If he has to fight hard, he has no chance of winning against Ji Yaoyue.
From this point of view, Chu Tianxiong saved him as soon as he appeared, which was a act of kindness.
Chu Tianxiong's attitude towards Lu Jin also aroused the surprise of everyone present.
The leader of the sect, who had never seen the dragon before his eyes, could make such an intimate gesture, which was enough to show how much he cared about Lu Jin.
Chu Tianxiong continued:
"How about this. One month later, the Blood Moon Holy Land will select disciples at the Eight Blood Dragon Altar. According to the rules of the Wanjian Sect, three days before the selection, I, the Wanjian Sect, will select the outstanding disciples who will participate in the selection of the Eight Blood Dragon Altar. Then you will have a duel. If you want to take revenge or complain, we and other senior leaders of the sect will definitely not interfere. What do you think?"
After hearing this, the expressions of everyone present changed!
They didn't expect the sect master to say such words, but they could also see that the sect leader wanted to give Lu Jin a chance, and of course, also give Liu Ruyan a chance.
Both of them are martial arts geniuses and outstanding disciples of his Wanjian Sect. Although less than a month is short, they have a lot of potential.The possibilities are endless, we don’t know who will win when the time comes!
And the last one left in the sect must be the stronger one!
Hearing this, Lu Jin nodded slightly, and then said:
"Lord Sect Leader!"
"If I remember correctly, any disciple can challenge in that duel, and if both parties agree, they can also sign a life-and-death certificate?"
Hearing this, everyone immediately understood Lu Jin's intention. He wanted to have a life-and-death fight with Liu Ruyan in that duel!
Chu Tianxiong's expression remained unchanged, he nodded and said:
"Yes, those who can enter the Blood Moon Holy Land are all outstanding martial arts monks. If they can't survive to the end, what kind of genius are they?"
Lu Jin's eyes were cold, he looked at Liu Ruyan and said coldly:
"Then, I will declare a life and death battle with you today! Liu Ruyan, you, the saint of Wanjian Sect, dare to fight with me!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone present looked at Liu Ruyan!
Now it seems that although Lu Jin's cultivation is still in the spirit bead realm, his combat power seems to have surpassed Liu Ruyan!
And there is no way of knowing how far Lu Jin will grow after a month!
However, he must have been even more powerful at that time!
Although Liu Ruyan has the Supreme Bone in her body, it is not completely integrated as Lu Jin said. It is even more difficult to determine how far she can practice.
Liu Ruyan secretly grinded her teeth and looked at Ji Yaoyue.
But Ji Yaoyue didn't speak immediately.
Lu Jin had tried his best to confront her before, which was enough to show that he still had some unknown secrets!
Not knowing the other party’s details is the most dangerous thing!
At this moment, Master Fox’s voice sounded in Liu Ruyan’s mind again:
"Promise him!"
"In less than ten days, you are expected to reach the second-level golden elixir realm. At that time, you will be qualified to practice the second-level technique of the Great Looting Immortal Technique. Once you have mastered it, you will be able to fight even at the fourth-level golden elixir realm! Killing him will be a piece of cake when the time comes!"
Hearing this, Liu Ruyan nodded secretly, then looked at Lu Jin and said in a cold voice:
"Okay! I promise you!"
After saying these words, Ji Yaoyue's eyes also changed.
"Ruyan, are you sure you want to fight him to the death?"
"Master, don't worry. I am about to break through to the second-grade golden elixir. Once I break through, my combat power will soar. It's impossible for him to kill me if he's just in the Spiritual Pearl realm!"
Ji Yaoyue nodded slightly:
"In that case, then... my teacher will do my best to help you break through!"
"Thank you Master!"
Ji Yaoyue said and looked at Chu Tianxiong:
"Sect Master, this is the end of the matter. Please take your leave first!"
With that said, he took Liu Ruyan and left.
Lu Jin looked at Liu Ruyan's leaving figure. Although he was unwilling to do so, he could only press down temporarily.
However, just a few days after he woke up, his cultivation had improved by leaps and bounds. He was full of expectations for the life and death arena in more than twenty days!
"Lu Jin, come with me."
Chu Tianxiong said lightly, and immediately grabbed Lu Jin's arm, and the two disappeared on the spot.
On the Saintess Peak, everyone who witnessed this battle had mixed emotions.
"I didn't expect that Lu Jin would be so powerful when he returned three years ago!"
"Even the sect leader came forward to protect him. If he can defeat the saint, his future will be bright!"
"Want to kill the Saint in the arena of life and death? Haha, the Saint is the one that Senior Brother Yang Dingfeng likes, and it is rumored that Elder Chiyu of the Blood Moon Holy Land has already decided to join the Holy Land. If Lu Jin dares to kill the Saint, he will be slapping the Blood Moon Holy Land in the face!"
"How did Senior Brother Lu Jin survive these three years of being framed? I would like to see him become stronger..."
"..."
While everyone was discussing, the expressions in the eyes of Elder Luo Jiu and others became more complicated.
With what happened today, they undoubtedly completely offended Lu Jin.
If Lu Jin really killed the saint in that life-and-death contest, I'm afraid their end would be miserable!
Just when a few people were struggling, they suddenly received a transmission note.
"I have been summoned by Peak Master Ji? Come with me, everyone!"
